data.title: Feelings — Beginner · Lesson 4
data.subject: feelings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Sunny day at the beach, feeling free…

[Hook]
Happy… Feliz
How do you feel?… ¿Cómo te sientes?
Sad… Triste
Let it out… Sácalo
Feelings in the sun.

[Verse]
Waves are crashing, seagulls fly,
Surprised… Sorprendido by the ocean's cry.
Nervous… Nervioso, heart beats fast,
Proud… Orgulloso of the moments that last.
Walking on the sand, feeling the heat,
Fear… Miedo fades when our hands meet.
Well… Bien, I’m doing just fine,
Embarrassed… Avergonzado, but you’re by my side.

[Hook]
Happy… Feliz
How do you feel?… ¿Cómo te sientes?
Sad… Triste
Let it out… Sácalo
Feelings in the sun.

[Verse]
Guilty… Culpable for the time we lost,
Impatient… Impaciente for the tide to cross.
Laughter in the air, smiles all around,
In this moment, love is found.
The sun is shining, the world feels right,
With you here, everything’s bright.
Feelings come, feelings go,
In the sun's warm glow.

[Bridge]
Let the rhythm move your soul,
In this sunny, coastal stroll.
Feelings deep, like the sea,
